Requirements: pip install python-docx reportlab Usage: 1. Update the SMTP configuration below with your mail server details. 2. Run: python send_report.py """ import os import smtplib import sys from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart from email.mime.base import MIMEBase from email.mime.text import MIMEText from email import encoders from docx import Document from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import LETTER from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle from reportlab.lib.units import inch from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Configuration — update these values before running # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example.com" SMTP_PORT = 587 SMTP_USER = "your_email@example.com" SMTP_PASSWORD = "your_password" SENDER_EMAIL = "your_email@example.com" RECIPIENT_EMAIL = "bob@example.com" EMAIL_SUBJECT = "Customer Activity Report" EMAIL_BODY = ( "Hi Bob,\n\n" "Please find the Customer Activity Report attached as a PDF.\n\n" "Best regards" ) DOCX_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "customer_report.docx") PDF_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "customer_report.pdf") # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Step 1: Convert .docx to PDF # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def convert_docx_to_pdf(docx_path: str, pdf_path: str) -> None: """Read a .docx file and produce a styled PDF using ReportLab.""" doc = Document(docx_path) styles = getSampleStyleSheet() styles.add(ParagraphStyle( name="ReportTitle", parent=styles["Title"], fontSize=18, spaceAfter=14, )) styles.add(ParagraphStyle( name="CustomerName", parent=styles["Heading2"], fontSize=13, spaceAfter=4, spaceBefore=10, )) styles.add(ParagraphStyle( name="Detail", parent=styles["Normal"], fontSize=9, leading=12, leftIndent=0.25 * inch, )) styles.add(ParagraphStyle( name="OrderItem", parent=styles["Normal"], fontSize=9, leading=12, leftIndent=0.5 * inch, )) pdf = SimpleDocTemplate( pdf_path, pagesize=LETTER, topMargin=0.75 * inch, bottomMargin=0.75 * inch, leftMargin=0.75 * inch, rightMargin=0.75 * inch, ) story: list = [] for para in doc.paragraphs: text = para.text.strip() if not text: continue # Heuristic styling based on content if text == "Customer Activity Report": story.append(Paragraph(text, styles["ReportTitle"])) story.append(Spacer(1, 6)) elif not text.startswith(("Order ", " Items:", "Email:")): # Customer name line story.append(Paragraph(f"{text}", styles["CustomerName"])) elif text.startswith("Email:"): story.append(Paragraph(text, styles["Detail"])) elif text.startswith("Order "): story.append(Paragraph(text, styles["Detail"])) elif text.startswith("Items:"): story.append(Paragraph(text, styles["OrderItem"])) else: story.append(Paragraph(text, styles["Detail"])) pdf.build(story) print(f"PDF created: {pdf_path}") # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Step 2: Email the PDF # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def send_email(pdf_path: str) -> None: """Send an email with the PDF attached via SMTP.""" msg = MIMEMultipart() msg["From"] = SENDER_EMAIL msg["To"] = RECIPIENT_EMAIL msg["Subject"] = EMAIL_SUBJECT msg.attach(MIMEText(EMAIL_BODY, "plain")) with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f: part = MIMEBase("application", "pdf") part.set_payload(f.read()) encoders.encode_base64(part) part.add_header( "Content-Disposition", f'attachment; filename="{os.path.basename(pdf_path)}"', ) msg.attach(part) with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as server: server.starttls() server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD) server.sendmail(SENDER_EMAIL, RECIPIENT_EMAIL, msg.as_string()) print(f"Email sent to {RECIPIENT_EMAIL}") # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Main # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- def main() -> None: if not os.path.exists(DOCX_PATH): sys.exit(f"Error: {DOCX_PATH} not found.") convert_docx_to_pdf(DOCX_PATH, PDF_PATH) send_email(PDF_PATH) print("Done.") if __name__ == "__main__": main() ``` That is the complete script — there is nothing omitted or truncated.
